## Introduction

## Approach

Code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)

artists <- c("Claude Monet", "Vincent van Gogh", "Pablo Picasso", "Rembrandt",
             "Johannes Vermeer", "Edgar Degas", "Henri Matisse", "Andy Warhol",
             "Georgia O'Keeffe", "Frida Kahlo", "Jean-Michel Basquiat",
             "Katsushika Hokusai", "John Singer Sargent", "Winslow Homer",
             "Jackson Pollock", "Mark Rothko", "Edward Hopper", "Kara Walker",
             "Yayoi Kusama", "Jacob Lawrence", "Mary Cassatt", "Francisco Goya",
             "Gustav Klimt", "Albrecht Dürer")

# Met: number of objects matching an artist (extra filters via ...)
met_count <- function(artist, ...) {
  request("https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org/public/collection/v1.1/search") |>
    req_user_agent("Project-3 class project") |>
    req_url_query(artistOrCulture = "true", ..., limit = 1, q = artist) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json() |>
    pluck("total", .default = 0L)
}

# NYT: number of Arts-section articles mentioning the artist
nyt_hits <- function(artist, begin = "20000101", end = "20251231") {
  resp <- request("https://api.nytimes.com/svc/search/v2/articlesearch.json") |>
    req_url_query(
      q = paste0('"', artist, '"'),
      fq = 'section.name:"Arts"',
      begin_date = begin, end_date = end,
      `api-key` = Sys.getenv("NYT_API_KEY")
    ) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json()
  Sys.sleep(12)  # stay under 5 requests/minute
  resp$response$meta$hits %||% resp$response$metadata$hits %||% NA_integer_
}

coverage <- tibble(artist = artists) |>
  mutate(
    met_objects    = map_int(artist, met_count),
    met_on_view    = map_int(artist, \(a) met_count(a, isOnView = "true")),
    met_highlights = map_int(artist, \(a) met_count(a, isHighlight = "true")),
    nyt_articles   = map_int(artist, nyt_hits)
  )

write_csv(coverage, "artist_coverage.csv")  # pull once, then read the CSV
```

```{r}
coverage
```
